ArticleSort.description: Article ordering supported by this command.

ArticleSource.description: Source selectors supported by article search.

ArticleType.description: Publication-type selectors sent to the named sources.

GeneInput.description: An input classified before source resolution; aliases remain free text.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision.

Text.description: Nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Checked search selectors and pool cursor.

author.description: Author words sent to PubMed's author field.

gene.description: Gene input; PubMed resolves it through HGNC.

journal.description: Journal words sent to PubMed's journal field.

no_preprints.description: Exclude preprints using the source's native filter.

offset.description: Number of pool items to skip.

open_access.description: Require the source's native open-access filter; Semantic Scholar means a public PDF.

pool.description: Stable snapshot from an earlier response.

retracted.description: Include retracted papers by default, or exclude them using a native filter.

since.description: Inclusive lower publication-date bound at the stated precision; PubMed matches either electronic or print date.

sort.description:
rank (default): native provider order; several sources take turns; native search cost.
date: native search cost; PubMed means date added and Europe PMC means newest first; other sources refuse it.
citations: most cited first across the whole pool; adds iCite calls, about 1 s per 1,000 PMIDs.
All sources support citations.

source.description:
Sources to search in caller order, comma separated. Default: pubmed.
Several sources take turns, remove duplicates and show every native rank.
pubmed: keywords with PubMed MeSH mapping; dropped words appear as notices.
europepmc: words in open full text and preprints; incidental mentions are possible.
litvar: exact variant publications; requires --variant and a protein change needs --gene; unresolved inputs return candidates.
semantic-scholar: broad discovery; a shared keyless pool may return 429; an optional free key raises the limit.
litsense: sentence resemblance, not a match; unrelated hits and timeouts are possible.
pubtator: entity and word search including full text; needs the right entity ID; --gene uses HGNC Entrez identity and cannot run without that join.

text.description: Words sent to each named source in its default fields.

until.description: Inclusive upper publication-date bound at the stated precision; PubMed matches either electronic or print date.

title: ArticleSearch
